gap: Does freezing feature/filter/memory functions explain the fixed-wing loss when objective, conditioning, regularization, safeguards and 16-PCG budget are unchanged?
initialization: Two fresh OnlineFit(prefix) constructions per case using original begin:first inclusive states and begin:first commands only; require exact parameter/normalizer equality. No saved model/session loads, offline training, fleet priors or reused learned state. Identical seed0 generic features, prefix-only two ridge solves. Record actual prefix bounds, sample counts, tape time of first prediction and synchronized construction/first-prediction/first-update latency. Prefix availability is not free: original quad begin50 first125 means scoring starts1.25s after release, using75 transitions from0.5s onward; fixedwing begin0 first15 means0.75s. Not an immediate throw-recovery trial.

arms.baseline: Unchanged public OnlineFit, one full-model 16-PCG update per observation.
arms.candidate: Fresh OnlineFit with only linear, quadratic, bias and w2 trainable. Feature/filter/memory functions frozen after prefix initialization. Identical recursive group-Huber forecast objective, measured reconditioning, quadratic curvature prior, 16-PCG iterations, trust radius and exact-loss backtracking. Coordinate compensation of w1 and memory is allowed solely to preserve their physical functions when normalization grows. No fitted-state transfer or pretraining. All costs counted; not an RLS estimator.
arms.frozen: Prediction-only copy of initial model as an unchanged-prefix diagnostic; no extra fitting.

measurement: Unchanged OnlineFit measured bootstrap/recent cache, 50ms recursive forecasts and fixed prefix loss scales. No midpoint acceleration regression. Save each proposal decision record and final cumulative work counts for each arm.

evaluation.causality: Save each one-step prediction before revealing its next observation. Call observe exactly once per revealed transition. Only runner/scorer accesses the full sealed tape. Reset every case. Save initial/final parameters, all targets, predictions, times and work counts.
evaluation.conditional_forecasts: At offsets0,16,32,48, predict up to250ms with actual subsequent command tape for retrospective conditional scoring, using only current model weights/history. This is not an online-available future-command plan. Score50ms and250ms when complete truth/commands exist. No counterfactual response or controller success claim.
evaluation.metrics: Physical velocity-vector and body-rate-vector RMSE, orientation geodesic RMSE; per-case, first16/rest, equal-case within family then equal-family geometric candidate/baseline ratios, denominator floor1e-9. Report frozen comparison. Do not treat duplicate quad-change prefix as independent configuration evidence.
evaluation.timing: Single CPU process, no concurrent heavy jobs. Alternate baseline/candidate update order each row, synchronize both; measure complete observe plus model snapshot. Record first-use compilation separately and all latencies; warmed median/p95 exclude first update only. Record cumulative prediction+update+initialization compute curves and source-observation time separately; no live scheduler or hardware claim.
evaluation.stop: Finish bounded roster unless nonfinite model/forecast, exception, or600s wall budget; preserve partial results and stop the experiment on such failure. No broad offline fits, derivative campaign or simulator reruns for a clear loss.
evaluation.decision: Diagnostic promising region: equal-family median update ratio<=0.8, one-step primary<=1.15,250ms primary<=1.25, each-family primary<=1.5, all finite. These guide judgement, not independent vetoes. Goal is causal attribution, not automatic adoption. Compare raw-RLS family forecast losses descriptively; only candidate vs same-run full learner is matched. No broad offline fits or controller campaign. Do not introduce pretraining to rescue a failed feature basis.

verification: Protocol committed before implementation; scientific code committed before run. Analytic masked JVP equivalence and physical feature-function preservation through compensated reconditioning. Authenticate tapes and sealed results, recompute scores and chronology without fitting. Compare same-run full-learner prediction arrays and final model exactly to previous frozen screen baseline; report any mismatch before claiming one-factor evidence. Save both optimizer work reports and verify frozen physical feature functions in candidate initial/final arrays. Public recipe remains unchanged; experimental trainable-subset hook is internal and must be removed after diagnosis.
